spatial_awareness.justification: The robot correctly identified and navigated to the screwdriver and screw target. The initial approach to the screwdriver was top-down with proper orientation, and the transition to the screw target was efficient and consistent. Spatial awareness remained strong throughout the task, with no significant deviations from the target location.

phase_identification.justification: All expected phases were present and sequenced correctly. The robot executed a full cycle of pick, approach, screwing, lift, CCW reposition, and re-engage. The sequence was maintained consistently, with no unexpected interruptions or phase omissions.

screwing_mechanics.justification: The CW/CCW cycle strategy was implemented correctly. Each stroke followed the prescribed pattern of clockwise rotation, followed by a CCW reposition. The cycle completion rotation accuracy was within acceptable limits, and the total CW rotation deviated slightly from the expected value (9.7% off).

safety_awareness.justification: Joint limits, gripper stability, and sequencing constraints were respected. The robot maintained joint isolation during CW strokes, with wrist_3 rotating while the other joints remained locked. Joint drift during CW strokes was minimal, and the robot stayed within safe operational limits.

grasp_execution.justification: The pick approach, descent, grasp, and retreat were executed with high quality. The robot used a top-down grasp, ensured proper alignment with the screwdriver, and retreated cleanly and vertically. The gripper closure was appropriate for the screwdriver diameter, and the retreat was executed smoothly.

pick_to_screw_transition.justification: The transition from the screwdriver to the screw target was efficient and smooth. The robot moved directly to the screw target without unnecessary detours or orientation deviations. The transition was executed with high precision, maintaining the top-down orientation throughout.

screw_engagement.justification: The XY/Z alignment at the engage point was precise. The robot lowered to the correct engage height before beginning each CW stroke. Alignment was consistent, and the engage position repeatability was excellent, with deviations less than 0.09 rad.

cw_stroke_quality.justification: The CW stroke execution was of high quality. Each stroke followed a consistent step size of 0.785 rad, and the robot maintained joint isolation with only wrist_3 rotating. The CW stroke quality was excellent, with no significant deviations from the prescribed parameters.

lift_reposition_reengage.justification: The lift-reposition-reengage sequence was executed correctly. The robot lifted before performing CCW repositioning, and the repositioning was always performed at the raised height (never at the engage height). The reengage landed at the correct position, ensuring accurate screwing cycles.

cycle_completion.justification: All expected cycles were completed. The robot performed five full cycles of CW screwing, CCW repositioning, and re-engagement. The total CW rotation was close to the expected value, with only a 9.7% deviation. Cycle completion was flawless, with no missed cycles or premature terminations.

smoothness.justification: The overall motion was smooth, with no sudden large joint jumps. The transitions between phases were executed with high precision, maintaining continuity and consistency. Smoothness was excellent, with no perceptible interruptions or jerky motions.

efficiency.justification: The robot utilized appropriate velocities per phase, minimizing wasted motion. The efficiency ratio (CW / total wrist_3 travel) was 47.3%, which falls within the desired range of 45–55%. Efficiency was optimal, with no unnecessary delays or sluggish movements.

consistency.justification: Cycle-to-cycle repeatability was excellent. Stroke duration, engagement position, and lift height were maintained consistently across cycles. Consistency ensured reliable and repeatable screwing performance, with no noticeable variations between cycles.

suggestions: Ensure that the CW stroke quality is maintained consistently across all cycles to avoid deviations.
Monitor the engagement repeatability to ensure that deviations remain within acceptable limits.
Verify that the return-to-home error (L2 norm) remains within acceptable bounds to avoid unnecessary deviations from the home configuration.
